propositions: A plan asserts that a named module provides or lacks a specific capability, but the assertion is false against the actual code (capability absent when claimed present, or present when claimed absent)

The four-pass plan-review machinery (finder, verifier, decider, coach) must include a new AGENT-tier criterion that detects and grades capability-surface mismatches by reading the codebase and resolving symbols

The criterion must be registered as advisory (never blocking) in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER, with routing entry and rubric prompt, and must pass all registration invariant validation

A bounded sanity check with 3 E1-verified missed cases (dc58, db7b, 5886) and 3 clean controls must demonstrate ≥66% recall on misses and record false-fire rate as promotion-gate dogfood data for future blocking transition
The criterion must auto-integrate into the standing criterion-effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring
The advisory posture and future dogfood-gated promotion protocol must be documented in the rubric, guide, and plan-review-gate.md
